messages:
Jordan: Quick heads-up  after the launch posts + webinar push the KPI board shows sessions +22% but MQLs flat. Can we triage before Monday?
Priya: Noted. We changed CTA variants mid-run (/launch vs /spotlight) so UTM fragmentation is likely.
Felix: Also the webinar follow-up email used partner redirect that doesn't include utm_source, so some traffic is landing as 'referral'.
DashboardBot: Quick pull: sessions by landing:
home_new: 14,200 sessions, 410 leads, 36 MQLs
launch_spot: 4,800 sessions, 92 leads, 3 MQLs
mini_lite: 3,100 sessions, 48 leads, 1 MQL
Priya: Looks like mini_lite has the short form; registration->MQL delay expected.
Jordan: Action: Priya reconcile UTMs + referrer and share CSV, Felix annotate dashboard for partner redirects, I'll add a blurb to the weekly KPI notes about form variants and timing. Target Monday 09:00 PT.
Felix: Will add dashboard annotation now.
DashboardBot: Annotation added: "2026-04-05 partner redirect traffic and CTA variant change may impact UTM attribution and raw lead counts."
Priya: I'll post the reconciliation CSV here when ready.
Jordan: Thanks, closing for now unless blockers surface.
